newsitem.title: JAPAN: Cosmo Oil to start advanced desulphuriser on Dec 1.
newsitem.headline: Cosmo Oil to start advanced desulphuriser on Dec 1.

text.p: Cosmo Oil Co Ltd said on Friday that it plans to start commercial operation of a 25,000 barrel-per-day (bpd) advanced gas oil desulphurisation unit at its Sakai refinery in western Japan on December 1.
Cosmo installed the 4.5 billion yen unit to meet stringent standards on sulphur content in gas oil to be introduced next year, a Cosmo spokesman said.
The government is to lower the maximum allowable sulphur content in gas oil to 0.05 percent in October 1997 from the current 0.2 percent.
A similar unit with a capacity of 45,000 bpd has been in operation at Cosmo's Chiba plant, near Tokyo, since 1994.
